curation.name: Microduck Straight Running
curation.summary: PPO running policy with a required heading-hold controller; the publisher reports 1.802 m/s straight progress over 30 seconds and states the 1.9 m/s target was not reached.
curation.details: No machine-readable policy manifest is published with this artifact, so runtime facts remain unknown. The publisher describes the gain over the previous public model as small (+0.38% 30-second straight speed) and below its predeclared useful-improvement threshold, publishing it as a research update with comparison evidence.
curation.notes: No manifest is published; the ONNX interface is inspected only. The registry records no independent hardware evidence.

publisher_hardware.note: The publisher reports held-out simulation tests only and no physical MicroDuck deployment evidence.
